<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button as SdkButton } from '@ui-sdk/vue/button'
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { buttonVariants } from './variants'
import type { ButtonSize, ButtonVariant } from './variants'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type ButtonProps = {
  variant?: ButtonVariant
  size?: ButtonSize
  /** Rendered element or component. Links pass as: 'a'. */
  as?: string | Component
  /** Native button type; ignored when `as` is not a button. */
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'
  /** Disables interaction and marks the button as busy. */
  loading?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}

type ClickHandler = (event: MouseEvent) => void

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ButtonProps>(), {
  variant: 'primary',
  size: 'md',
  as: 'button',
  type: 'button',
  loading: false,
  disabled: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()

// The click listener is attached by this component so that `loading` and
// `disabled` also block it for non-button roots such as links.
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  delete rest.onClick
  return rest
})

const isNativeButton = computed(() => props.as === 'button')
const isInert = computed(() => props.disabled || props.loading)

function onClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
  if (isInert.value) {
    event.preventDefault()
    event.stopImmediatePropagation()
    return
  }
  const raw = attrs.onClick as ClickHandler | ClickHandler[] | undefined
  if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
    for (const handler of raw) handler(event)
  } else {
    raw?.(event)
  }
}

function onAuxClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
  if (isInert.value) {
    event.preventDefault()
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <component
    :is="isNativeButton ? SdkButton : as"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :type="isNativeButton ? type : undefined"
    :class="
      cn(
        isNativeButton && 'h-auto border-0',
        buttonVariants({ variant, size }),
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
    :disabled="isNativeButton ? isInert : undefined"
    :tabindex="!isNativeButton && isInert ? -1 : (attrs.tabindex as number | string | undefined)"
    :aria-disabled="isInert ? 'true' : undefined"
    :aria-busy="loading ? 'true' : undefined"
    @click="onClick"
    @auxclick="onAuxClick"
  >
    <slot name="progress" />
    <slot name="leading" />
    <slot />
    <slot name="trailing" />
  </component>
</template>

export { default as Button } from './Button.vue'
export { buttonVariants } from './variants'
export type { ButtonSize, ButtonVariant } from './variants'
export type { ButtonProps } from './Button.vue'

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Input as SdkInput } from '@ui-sdk/vue/input'
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  delete rest['aria-invalid']
  return rest
})

export type InputProps = {
  /** Marks the field as invalid and paints the border with the danger colour. */
  invalid?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  id?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<InputProps>(), {
  invalid: false,
  disabled: false,
  id: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<string | number>({ default: '' })

function useNativeInput() {
  return ['number', 'range', 'file', 'checkbox', 'radio', 'date', 'time', 'color'].includes(
    String(attrs.type ?? ''),
  )
}

function fieldAttrs() {
  return {
    ...forwarded.value,
    id: props.id,
    disabled: props.disabled,
    'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid.value,
    class: cn(
      'h-11 w-full rounded-control border border-line bg-control px-3 text-[15px] text-ink',
      'placeholder:text-ink-muted',
      'outline-none focus-visible:border-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-ink',
      'aria-[invalid=true]:border-danger aria-[invalid=true]:focus-visible:outline-danger',
      'disabled:cursor-default disabled:opacity-55',
      'transition-[background-color,color,border-color,outline-color,box-shadow] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-normal)] ease-out-expo motion-reduce:transition-none',
      attrs.class as ClassValue,
    ),
  }
}

const ariaInvalid = computed(() => {
  if (props.invalid) return 'true'
  return attrs['aria-invalid'] as 'true' | 'false' | 'grammar' | 'spelling' | undefined
})
</script>

<template>
  <input v-if="useNativeInput()" v-model="model" v-bind="fieldAttrs()" />
  <SdkInput
    v-else
    v-bind="fieldAttrs()"
    :value="String(model)"
    @update:model-value="model = $event"
  />
</template>

export type { InputProps } from './Input.vue'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})

export type SwitchProps = {
  disabled?: boolean
  size?: 'md' | 'lg'
  controller?: SwitchController
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SwitchProps>(), {
  disabled: false,
  size: 'md',
  controller: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<boolean>({ default: false })
const isLarge = computed(() => props.size === 'lg')
const fallbackController = createSwitchController()
const controller = computed(() => props.controller ?? fallbackController)

function onEnter(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (event.defaultPrevented || props.disabled) return
  const target = event.currentTarget
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || target.matches(':disabled, [data-readonly]')) return

  event.preventDefault()
  controller.value.toggle({ reason: 'press', event })
}
</script>

    v-model:checked="model"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :controller="controller"
    :class="

import { Tabs as TabsRoot } from '@ui-sdk/vue/tabs'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type TabsProps = {
  defaultValue?: string | number
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
  /** 'automatic' follows arrow keys; 'manual' waits for Enter or Space. */
  activationMode?: 'automatic' | 'manual'
  /** Unmounts inactive panels instead of hiding them. */
  unmountOnHide?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<TabsProps>(), {
  defaultValue: undefined,
  orientation: 'horizontal',
  activationMode: 'automatic',
  unmountOnHide: false,
})

const model = defineModel<string | number>()
const loop = ref(true)
provide(tabsContext, { loop, unmountOnHide: toRef(props, 'unmountOnHide') })

const value = computed(() => (model.value === undefined ? undefined : encodeTab(model.value)))
const initial = computed(() =>
  props.defaultValue === undefined ? undefined : encodeTab(props.defaultValue),
)
</script>

    v-bind="$attrs"
    :value="value"
    :default-value="initial"
    class="block"
    :orientation="orientation"

    :loop="loop"
    @update:value="model = $event === null ? undefined : decodeTab($event)"

import {
  computed,

  loop?: boolean

  loop: true,

const context = inject(tabsContext)

  if (context) context.loop.value = props.loop

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }

  max?: number

items.description: Hand-written SVG bar strip for a numeric series, with median-based scaling and an optional baseline.
items.docs: Pass values as a number array; the component never formats labels for you. Bars fill 60% of each slot and the series is pinned to the right edge when slots is larger than the data. The value axis is capped at median x 3 so a few spikes cannot flatten the rest; with one or two samples it falls back to the maximum. <script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { StyleValue } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { SparklinePart } from './parts'
import { sparklinePath } from './geometry'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SparklineTone = 'default' | 'accent' | 'accent-alt'

export type SparklineProps = {
  values: readonly number[]
  /** Upper bound of the value axis; defaults to the median-based scale. */
  max?: number
  /** Draws a 1px rule at the bottom of the strip. */
  baseline?: boolean
  tone?: SparklineTone
  /** Accessible name. Without it the graphic is hidden from assistive technology. */
  ariaLabel?: string
  /** Bars are laid out across this many slots; the newest sits at the right edge. */
  slots?: number
  /**
   * Strip height, `font-size` relative. The reference puts the strip beside the 26px
   * value text, so `0.7em` there is about 18px; inside a Stat the figure slot
   * inherits that font size, and standalone use should set a font size on the parent.
   */
  height?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SparklineProps>(), {
  max: undefined,
  baseline: false,
  tone: 'default',
  ariaLabel: undefined,
  slots: undefined,
  height: '0.7em',
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  delete rest.style
  return rest
})

const toneClass = computed(
  () =>
    ({
      default: 'text-ink-faint',
      accent: 'text-accent',
      'accent-alt': 'text-danger',
    })[props.tone],
)

const path = computed(() =>
  sparklinePath({ values: props.values, slots: props.slots, max: props.max }),
)
const viewWidth = computed(() =>
  Math.max(props.slots ?? props.values.length, props.values.length, 1),
)

const labelled = computed(() => props.ariaLabel !== undefined)
</script>

items.docs: Wrap the app in ThemeProvider and read state with useTheme(): theme is the stored choice, resolvedTheme is what is painted. setTheme writes localStorage only when the choice changes, and system removes the key when defaultTheme is system so the OS preference keeps driving the page. <script setup lang="ts">
import { createLocalStorage, createPreference } from '@ui-sdk/core'
import { usePreference } from '@ui-sdk/vue/preferences'
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, provide, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import {
  DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY,
  applyThemeToDocument,
  systemTheme,
  type ResolvedTheme,
  type ThemeChoice,
} from './theme'
import { themeKey, type ThemeApi } from './context'

export type ThemeProviderProps = {
  storageKey?: string
  /** Used when nothing is stored yet. */
  defaultTheme?: ThemeChoice
  /** Attribute mirrored onto `html` so CSS can target the explicit choice. */
  attribute?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ThemeProviderProps>(), {
  storageKey: DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY,
  defaultTheme: 'system',
  attribute: 'data-theme',
})

const storage = createLocalStorage(props.storageKey)
const preference = createPreference({
  values: ['system', 'light', 'dark'],
  defaultValue: props.defaultTheme,
  attribute: 'data-p0seid0n-theme-preference',
  storage: {
    ...storage,
    set: (value) =>
      value === 'system' && props.defaultTheme === 'system' ? storage.remove() : storage.set(value),
  },
})
const preferenceState = usePreference(preference)
const theme = computed({
  get: () => preferenceState.value.value,
  set: (next: ThemeChoice) => {
    preference.set(next)
  },
})
const resolvedTheme = ref<ResolvedTheme>(props.defaultTheme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light')
const hydrated = ref(false)

let media: MediaQueryList | undefined

function sync(): void {
  resolvedTheme.value = applyThemeToDocument(theme.value, props.attribute)
}

function setTheme(next: ThemeChoice): void {
  theme.value = next
}

watch(theme, sync)

function onSystemChange(): void {
  // Only matters while following the system; a pinned choice ignores it.
  if (theme.value === 'system') sync()
}

onMounted(() => {
  sync()
  hydrated.value = true
  media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
  media.addEventListener('change', onSystemChange)
})

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  media?.removeEventListener('change', onSystemChange)
})

const api: ThemeApi = {
  theme,
  resolvedTheme,
  setTheme,
  systemTheme,
  get storageKey() {
    return props.storageKey
  },
}
provide(themeKey, api)

const ready = computed(() => hydrated.value)
defineExpose({ ready, theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme })
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>

export { default as ThemeProvider } from './ThemeProvider.vue'
export { useTheme, DEFAULT_STORAGE_KEY } from './context'
export { applyThemeToDocument, readStoredTheme, systemTheme, themeScript } from './theme'
export type { ThemeApi } from './context'
export type { ThemeProviderProps } from './ThemeProvider.vue'
export type { ResolvedTheme, ThemeChoice } from './theme'

import type { ChangeDetails } from '@ui-sdk/core'
import {
  Select as SelectRoot,
  type SelectOpenChangeReason,
  type SelectValueChangeReason,
} from '@ui-sdk/vue/select'
import { provide } from 'vue'
import { selectItems } from './selection'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type SelectProps = {
  /** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  name?: string
  required?: boolean
  autocomplete?: string
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SelectProps>(), {
  defaultValue: undefined,
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  disabled: false,
  name: undefined,
  required: false,
  autocomplete: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<string>()
const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
const items = new Map<string, (event: Event) => void>()
const selections = new WeakMap<Event, boolean>()
provide(selectItems, items)

function emitSelection(value: string, originalEvent: Event | undefined) {
  const event = new CustomEvent('select.select', {
    bubbles: true,
    cancelable: true,
    detail: { originalEvent, value },
  })
  items.get(value)?.(event)
  return event.defaultPrevented
}

function onValueChange(value: string | null, details: ChangeDetails<SelectValueChangeReason>) {
  if (value === null || details.reason !== 'item-press') return
  const canceled = emitSelection(value, details.event)
  if (details.event) selections.set(details.event, canceled)
  if (canceled) details.cancel()
}

function onOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<SelectOpenChangeReason>) {
  if (next || details.reason !== 'item-press') return
  const event = details.event
  const current = model.value ?? props.defaultValue
  const canceled =
    (event && selections.get(event)) ?? (current !== undefined && emitSelection(current, event))
  if (event) selections.delete(event)
  if (canceled) details.cancel()
}
</script>

    v-model:open="open"
    :multiple="false"
    :value="model === '' ? null : model"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, toRef, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Accordion as AccordionRoot } from '@ui-sdk/vue/accordion'
import { accordionUnmountOnHide } from './context'
import { navigateAccordion } from './keyboard'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AccordionProps = {
  /** Whether one item or several items can stay open at once. */
  type?: 'single' | 'multiple'
  /** Allows closing the active item when `type` is `"single"`. */
  collapsible?: boolean
  defaultValue?: string | string[]
  disabled?: boolean
  unmountOnHide?: boolean
  orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<AccordionProps>(), {
  type: undefined,
  collapsible: true,
  defaultValue: undefined,
  disabled: false,
  unmountOnHide: true,
  orientation: 'vertical',
})

provide(accordionUnmountOnHide, toRef(props, 'unmountOnHide'))

const model = defineModel<string | string[]>()
const resolvedType = computed<'single' | 'multiple'>(
  () => props.type ?? (Array.isArray(model.value ?? props.defaultValue) ? 'multiple' : 'single'),
)

function toValues(value: string | string[] | undefined) {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? (value ? [value] : []) : value
}

function updateValue(values: string[]) {
  model.value = resolvedType.value === 'multiple' ? values : (values[0] ?? '')
}

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionRoot
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :value="toValues(model)"
    :multiple="resolvedType === 'multiple'"
    :collapsible="collapsible"
    :default-value="toValues(defaultValue)"
    :disabled="disabled"
    keep-mounted
    :data-orientation="orientation"
    :class="cn('w-full max-w-none border-t-0', attrs.class as ClassValue)"
    @update:value="updateValue"
    @keydown="navigateAccordion($event, orientation)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AccordionRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Progress as ProgressRoot, ProgressIndicator } from '@ui-sdk/vue/progress'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type ProgressTone = 'default' | 'accent' | 'danger'

export type ProgressProps = {
  /** Current value; omit or pass `null` for an indeterminate bar. */
  modelValue?: number | null
  max?: number
  tone?: ProgressTone
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<ProgressProps>(), {
  modelValue: null,
  max: 100,
  tone: 'default',
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})

const safeMax = computed(() =>
  typeof props.max === 'number' && Number.isFinite(props.max) && props.max > 0 ? props.max : 100,
)

const isIndeterminate = computed(
  () =>
    props.modelValue === null ||
    props.modelValue === undefined ||
    !Number.isFinite(props.modelValue),
)

const value = computed(() => (isIndeterminate.value ? null : props.modelValue))

const toneClass = computed(() => {
  if (props.tone === 'accent') return 'bg-accent'
  if (props.tone === 'danger') return 'bg-danger'
  return 'bg-ink'
})
</script>

<template>
  <ProgressRoot
    :value="value"
    :max="safeMax"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="
      cn(
        'relative block h-2.5 w-full min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-control',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
    "
  >
    <ProgressIndicator
      :class="
        cn(
          'relative inset-auto h-full rounded-full bg-none',
          toneClass,
          isIndeterminate
            ? 'w-2/5 motion-safe:animate-progress-indeterminate motion-reduce:translate-x-3/4'
            : 'transition-[width] duration-[var(--p0seid0n-duration-slow)] ease-out-expo motion-reduce:transition-none',
        )
      "
    />

import { computed, reactive, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Command as SdkCommand, type CommandValueChangeDetails } from '@ui-sdk/vue/command'
import {
  containsCommandText,
  matchesCommandItem,
  provideCommandContext,
  type CommandItemMeta,
} from './context'
import { useCommandSelection } from './selection'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type CommandProps = {
  filterDisabled?: boolean
  loop?: boolean
  multiple?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  defaultValue?: string | string[]
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<CommandProps>(), {
  filterDisabled: false,
  loop: true,
  multiple: false,
  disabled: false,
  defaultValue: undefined,
})

const model = defineModel<string | string[]>()
const searchTerm = defineModel<string>('searchTerm', { default: '' })

const items = reactive(new Map<string, CommandItemMeta>())

const filterDisabled = computed(() => props.filterDisabled)
const disabled = computed(() => props.disabled)
const multiple = computed(() => props.multiple)

const visibleIds = computed(() => {
  const set = new Set<string>()
  const query = searchTerm.value.trim()
  for (const [id, meta] of items) {
    if (
      props.filterDisabled ||
      query === '' ||
      matchesCommandItem(meta.value, meta.keywords, query, containsCommandText)
    ) {
      set.add(id)
    }
  }
  return set
})

const visibleChoices = computed(() =>
  [...visibleIds.value].flatMap((id) => {
    const item = items.get(id)
    return item && !item.disabled ? [item.value] : []
  }),
)
const selection = useCommandSelection(model, multiple, disabled, visibleChoices, props.defaultValue)

function onHighlight(value: string | null, details: CommandValueChangeDetails) {
  if (value !== null && details.reason === 'list-navigation' && details.event?.shiftKey) {
    selection.extend(value)
  }
}

provideCommandContext({
  search: searchTerm,
  disabled,
  multiple,
  isSelected: selection.isSelected,
  select: selection.select,
  filterDisabled,
  visibleIds,
  registerItem: (id, meta) => {
    items.set(id, meta)
  },
  unregisterItem: (id) => {
    items.delete(id)
  },
  matches: (value, keywords) => {
    if (props.filterDisabled) return true
    return matchesCommandItem(value, keywords, searchTerm.value, containsCommandText)
  },
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>

    v-model:query="searchTerm"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :loop="loop"
    :filter="() => true"
    :class="

        'flex h-full w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised text-ink',
        attrs.class as ClassValue,
      )
